dhp384:2: The commentary says this refers to the mastery of two things, serenity and discernment (cf. [dn34:1.3.5]()). However, the term is not “two” but “duality” (_dvaya_), suggesting a link to [sn35.92:2.2](), the duality of sense experience.
dhp416:1: This verse and the next are identical. The commentary says they were spoken on two separate occasions.
